chapter: Postwar years, accident and lean times
title: His 52nd Street group at the Three Deuces and the Apollo Mother's Day hit
summary: He had led groups before: a six-piece at the Three Deuces with Benny Waters and Una Mae Carlisle, expanded to twelve pieces for the Apollo, where Mr. Schiffman gave him a gift for a hat.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Was this the first time you'd had your own group, Herman?

No, I had different groups in and out, in and out before that, because I had a group here at 52nd Street. Una Mae Carlisle was playing piano for me, and augmented the band to twelve pieces, went in the Apollo Theater on Mother's Day, and we -- we did so much business, business had been falling off for months, and whatnot, that they did so much business Mr. Schiffman gave me an 85 or a hundred dollar to buy me a hat.
Eighty-five --
Eighty-five -- I think -- close to a hundred dollars, he gave me as --
Well, eighty-five to a hundred dollars for a hat?
Well, I mean, you know. For a present.
Right.
I would put it that way. It was a gift.
Right.
He say very fine, nice show, and he said buy yourself a little -- you know?
Now, when the band was on 52nd Street, where were you playing?
That's the -- oh, uh, uh, I want to say -- Deuces.
The Three Deuces?
Uh-huh. Uh-huh.
And how big a band was it, at the Deuces?
Six.
Six.
Six, and the --
Who was in the band? Besides --

Had Benny Waters -- Benny Waters, again, on Tenor; Una Mae Carlisle, piano; uh -- clarinet, clarinet, clarinet, who was on clarinet? Well no, Benny -- what's his -- Benny Waters did that, both, I'm trying to think did I have trombone, did I? I don't know. It seems -- six.
Six. Do you remember when this was? Roughly what year? And where was Fats?
